answer: One defence is Proof of unique deep-sea dive log with decompression table: dives logged with the same tables across a hundred descents, and the zephyr of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: dives logged with the same tables across a hundred descents is fresh per account, and the spiral is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the vine of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
